messages:
deploy-bot: Config-only deploy queued by alex. Service="inference-router". Change window 20:30-21:00 UTC. Rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% in stepped increments. Keys touched: routing.policy, request.timeout_ms, batching.*. Approve with :thumbsup: or reply with concerns. More details: https://internal.redwood/inference/releases/1715129999

alex: Kicking off preflight. Will start first canary at ~20:35 UTC. @sarah you oncall?

sarah: Oncall, watching latency + 5xx dashboards. I set the alert thresholds to +10% temporarily.

tess: Quick note — recommend pinning canary to model v2.1-quant to avoid kvcache churn.

ops-jen: Agreed. Also adding a temporary fallback route to legacy pool at 0.5% if errors exceed 1%.

sanjay: Config diff (intent):
```
routing:
  policy: weighted
  weights:
    default: 0.99
    canary: 0.01
request:
  timeout_ms: 4000 -> 3000
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048 -> 1024
  max_batch_size: 32 -> 16
```

alex: Rationale: tighten timeouts and cut batch sizes to protect p95 tail while we test the new routing weights. Canary small so cost/latency impact is minimal.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout now (1%). Initiated by alex. Monitoring targets: #metrics/inference-latency, #alerts/error-rate. Will auto-step to next percent every 10m if no abort.

sarah: Seeing a small p95 bump at 1% (~+4%) but no 5xx. Holding and watching for another 5m.

tess: p95 back to baseline after 10m. Recommend step to 3%.

alex: Proceeding to 3%. Adding release note draft: "Config-only: adjust routing weights, request timeout -> 3000ms, batching tokens -> 1024, max batch size -> 16. Canary pinned to v2.1-quant. Temporary fallback to legacy pool if errors >1%."

ops-jen: Pin confirmed. Also note rollback play: revert routing weights and restore previous batching/timeouts, then drain canary. Keep telemetry for 30m post-rollback.

sanjay: If we need to abort, plan: comment "abort" here, deploy-bot will stop and roll back immediately. Manual rollback steps are documented in runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary at 3%. Next automatic step in ~10m. To abort: reply "abort" in this thread.

sarah: :thumbsup: dashboards stable. No alerts.

alex: Thanks team — I'll keep posting updates. If all good we'll ramp to 10% in configured steps and then full rollout.
